speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.

The urinalysis confirms significant hematuria with sterile pyuria (positive leukocyte esterase but negative nitrites), and the CT scan revealing multiple cysts in the medullary collecting ducts is pathognomonic for this condition. Given the recurrent UTIs and hematuria, this fits the clinical picture perfectly.
